verdict.rationale: Column is a developer banking API, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers user-configurable background automations such as scheduled or rule-based transfers, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows adjacent features: webhooks for event notifications, monthly statements Column generates on its own, and API endpoints that a developer would have to orchestrate externally. None of these lets a user set up autonomous automations within the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
